light_description: Early Providence Stampede overdrive documented as the brand's first overdrive pedal lineage, with high headroom and broad dynamic range.
Current Providence Stampede OD with a wide dynamic range and elevated internal operating voltage for amp-like drive.
Historical Providence Sonic Drive generation preserved in the Japanese product lineage as a responsive, articulate overdrive.
Historical Providence Sonic Drive with fast attack and expressive low-to-high gain range, documented from 2009.
Later Sonic Drive generation with enhanced presence and FAT low-frequency gain control.
Providence Silky Drive overdrive with a tube-like, bright response and gain-boost switching documented in Japanese retail history.
Providence Flame Drive, described by the builder as a natural, versatile overdrive capable of edging into overtone-rich distortion.
Current Providence overdrive with warm, sticky distortion character and Japanese manufacture.
Historical Providence Heat Blaster high-gain distortion generation preserved in Japanese retail and product records.
Second documented Heat Blaster generation within the Providence distortion lineage.
Current Providence Heat Blaster distortion model listed in the Japanese-made guitar pedal lineup.
Historical Providence Stampede DT distortion with elevated internal voltage and wide gain range reaching fuzzy saturation.
Current Providence Stampede DT generation with broad gain range, two-band EQ and large-amp-style low end.
Historical Providence Great Deceiver distortion documented in the early Japanese boutique catalog.
Historical Providence Great Deceiver distortion companion model preserved in the product index.
Historical Providence Great Deceiver overdrive model documented from 2006.
Shun Nokina's Leqtique interpretation of the Maestro lineage, a smooth mid-focused overdrive documented from 2011 and later discontinued.
Leqtique overdrive evolved from MAR with increased low end, clarity, touch sensitivity and gain range.
Low-gain Leqtique drive designed to move from clean to light overdrive and also serve as a buffer or seasoning preamp.
High-gain Leqtique distortion with a mid control that shapes frequency response and overall balance.
Transparent-style Leqtique overdrive with smooth, responsive low-to-mid gain and separate high/low voicing controls.
Leqtique high-definition overdrive model preserved in the maker's current two-in-one customization catalog and historical lineup.
Named Leqtique overdrive model preserved as a selectable stage in the maker's current two-in-one pedal system.
Leqtique high-gain distortion model preserved in the brand's current modular two-in-one catalog.
Leqtique transparent-style drive concept represented in the maker's current two-in-one catalog as the mature development of the Roch/Beryl lineage.
Leqtique distortion model preserved in the current selectable two-in-one lineup.
Leqtique high-gain distortion model preserved in the current two-in-one catalog.
Leqtique overdrive model offered through the maker's shop-exclusive two-in-one system.
Leqtique drive model offered through the maker's shop-exclusive two-in-one system.
High-gain Japanese handmade distortion/preamp designed to reproduce the response of a driven stack amplifier with deep low end and strong pick attack.
Japanese handmade fuzz/distortion model documented since the 2010s and currently sold as an SF-5 compact fuzz-distortion.
TRIAL bass overdrive/distortion with separate overdrive and distortion controls, documented as a Japanese handmade product.
Premium fully handmade Japanese overdrive developed without mass-production constraints and with three voicing modes plus gain boost.
Historical TRIAL overdrive model preserved in Japanese secondary-market records and the builder's broader handmade product lineage.
Compact TRIAL fuzz model documented in Japanese retail listings as a fuzz-oriented dirt pedal.
